Fresh Google Group tester link · July 15, 2026

Join Aethon Beacon testing

This is the current tester page for Android and iPhone. If an older page appeared before, this fresh page replaces it. Android access now starts with the Aethon Beacon Google Group so new Gmail testers can request/join without waiting for an old email-list invite.

Android step 1: Join Google Group Android step 2: Join closed test Android: Install app iPhone: Install TestFlight iPhone: Request invite

Android testers

  1. Sign in with the same Gmail you use on Google Play.
  2. Tap Join Google Group and join aethon-beacon-android-testers@googlegroups.com.
  3. After joining the group, return here and tap Android step 2: Join closed test.
  4. If Play still says “only invited people can download,” Google may still be reviewing the tester-group switch. Submit your Gmail below so access/testify is recorded, then retry after Google review completes.
  5. After opt-in, install from Google Play and keep testing active for 14 days.
Record Android access/testify request

iPhone / TestFlight testers

  1. Install Apple TestFlight.
  2. Use the Apple ID email that was invited to Aethon Beacon TestFlight.
  3. If you do not have an invite yet, request iOS access below with your Apple ID email.
  4. After access is added, return to this page, accept the beta, and install.
  5. Send feedback/screenshots from TestFlight or email.

Android closed test note: Google Play access is being moved to the Aethon Beacon Google Group: aethon-beacon-android-testers@googlegroups.com. Use the same Gmail for Google Groups and Google Play. If Play says “only invited people can download,” join the group first, then retry the opt-in link. If it still blocks you, Google Play may still be finishing review of the tester-group change.
iOS TestFlight note: TestFlight beta installs require an invited Apple ID email or a public TestFlight link from App Store Connect. If the invite is missing, use Request iOS/TestFlight access and send the Apple ID email to be added.
Testify / feedback: After installing, testers should send one short report: platform, device, what worked, what failed, and one optional short testimony. This helps prove the test is active and collect release feedback.
